mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate rise above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp consumer demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs; the joint signal is stronger than individual series effects.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO growth below 0.5% monthly) causes inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of 60-day periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly real GDP expansion above 2.0% annualized rate indicates strong economic growth that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 5.0% triggers hawkish monetary policy that increases real interest rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases and nonfarm payrolls declines signal severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 4.5% YoY), a federal funds rate rise above 4.5% triggers monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of 60-day periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.
